items.quote: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh
items.claim: People met Moses and Aaron who stood in the way as they came from Pharaoh

items.quote: ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants
items.claim: Moses and Aaron made the people's reputation be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh and his servants
items.place: in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants

items.quote: to put a sword in their hand to slay us
items.claim: A sword would be put into their hand to slay the people
